title: Sequential densities of rational languages
summary: We introduce the notion of density of a rational language with respect to a sequence of probability measures. We prove that if $(μ_n)$ is a sequence of Bernoulli measures converging to a positive Bernoulli measure $\overlineμ$, the sequential density is the ordinary density with respect to $\overlineμ$. We also prove that if $(μ_n)$ is a sequence of invariant probability measures converging in the strong sense to an invariant probability measure $\overlineμ$, then the sequential density of every rational language exists for this sequence.
